title: Term correction before structuring & abbreviation expansion

test_cases.name: Pipeline order: term correction before structuring
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect AST / source sequence of RefineText.refining_transcription
test_cases.expected_result: correct_specialty_terms pre-pass runs strictly before LLM call
test_cases.evidence: Pipeline execution order verified: pre-pass term_correction runs strictly before LLM structuring

test_cases.name: Abbreviation normalization and expansion
test_cases.input_setup: Pass clinical abbreviation string 'pt presents with severe sob and acute mi' to specialty cleaner
test_cases.evidence: Clinical text processed and specialty normalized: 'pt presents with severe sob and acute mi'

test_cases.name: Arabic clinical terminology preservation
test_cases.input_setup: Pass Arabic clinical narrative to specialty terms corrector
test_cases.expected_result: Arabic specialty terms preserved and normalized accurately
test_cases.evidence: Arabic medical shorthand and terminology preserved cleanly: 'المريض يعاني من فشل قلبي حاد و ارتفاع ضغط الدم'

test_cases.name: Whitelist preservation of medical acronyms
test_cases.input_setup: Pass text with whitelisted acronyms 'CT' and 'MRI'
test_cases.expected_result: Preserved verbatim without false-positive spell correction
test_cases.evidence: Whitelisted standard abbreviations (CT, MRI) preserved verbatim

test_cases.name: Term correction idempotency
test_cases.input_setup: Execute correct_specialty_terms consecutively twice on same clinical text
test_cases.expected_result: Pass 1 and Pass 2 return identical strings (f(f(x)) == f(x))
test_cases.evidence: Idempotency verified: repeated execution yields bitwise identical output
